title: FAST-ML: A Hybrid Physics-Machine Learning Framework for Tropical Cyclone Intensity Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.25505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid intensification (RI) remains one of the most consequential and difficult aspects of tropical cyclone (TC) forecasting. Although full-physics numerical weather prediction models can represent the processes governing RI, resolving storm-environment interactions remains computationally expensive, while purely data-driven approaches often lack physical interpretability. We present FAST-ML, a hybrid framework that bridges data-driven efficiency with physical constraints. A physically informed dual-stream neural parameterization ingests 3D ERA5 fields to diagnose ventilation controls---environmental wind shear and mid-level entropy deficit. By optimizing these parameters end-to-end through a differentiable FAST intensity model, this architecture establishes a robust new paradigm for observation-driven parameter optimization, ensuring storm evolution remains strictly governed by thermodynamic principles. translated_title: FAST-ML：一种用于热带气旋强度预报的物理-机器学习混合框架
translated_abstract: 快速增强（RI）仍然是热带气旋（TC）预报中最关键且最困难的方面之一。尽管全物理数值天气预报模式能够表征控制快速增强的过程，但解析风暴-环境相互作用在计算上代价高昂，而纯数据驱动的方法往往缺乏物理可解释性。我们提出了FAST-ML，这是一个将数据驱动效率与物理约束相结合的混合框架。一个物理信息驱动的双流神经参数化方案接收三维ERA5场，以诊断通风控制因素——环境风切变和中层熵亏。通过可微分的FAST强度模型对这些参数进行端到端优化，该架构为观测驱动的参数优化建立了一个稳健的新范式，确保风暴演变严格遵循热力学原理。通过更好地捕捉风暴的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FAST-ML混合框架，利用物理信息驱动的双流神经参数化从三维ERA5场诊断环境风切变与中层熵亏等通风控制参数，并通过可微分FAST强度模型进行端到端优化，在严格遵循热力学物理约束的前提下高效预报热带气旋的快速增强。
